description: The SERVICES table contains information about patient transfers between different hospital services. Each row represents a single transfer event, identified by a unique ROW_ID. The table links patients (SUBJECT_ID) and their hospital admissions (HADM_ID) to the service they were transferred from (PREV_SERVICE) and to (CURR_SERVICE), along with the timestamp of the transfer (TRANSFERTIME).

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: TRANSFERTIME
columns.description: The date and time when the patient was transferred.

columns.name: PREV_SERVICE
columns.description: The service the patient was on prior to the current transfer, e.g., 'CMED' (Cardiothoracic Medical).

columns.name: CURR_SERVICE
columns.description: The service the patient is currently on, e.g., 'CMED' (Cardiothoracic Medical).
